thread:
maya: Quick sync — Optimize toolkit prioritization. Customers keep asking for cost-aware inference recommendations + eval-triggered alerts. Need to decide MVP for alpha pilot. Can we list must-haves vs nice-to-haves by EOD? cc @alex @jordan @eva @samir

alex: On it. Quick take: must-have = batching config suggestions (per-model seq-length aware), cache hints (prefix/KV reuse), and quantization recommendations. Nice-to-have = per-customer dollar estimates and automatic profile tuning.

jordan: Agree with alex. Also must-have: eval-triggered alert hooks (webhook + diff threshold). We should include a basic baseline + sample prompts to avoid obvious noise.

eva: From CS: customers want a simple "estimate cost impact" output and a short rollout/rollback note. Pilot customers will not accept opaque recommendations.

samir: ML caveat: quant recs need offline validation; we can ship heuristic suggestions (layer-sensitivity flag + expected token delta) but must surface uncertainty. Example rec: q4f16 -> +2% latency, -40% GPU memory.

alex: Engineering note: to produce batching recs we need telemetry: token-seq distribution + prefix-hit-rate + p50/p95 latency by model. Console has partial metrics; we'll need two new fields in metrics pipeline.

maya: Proposed MVP scope (alpha):
- batching + cache recommendations (exportable JSON + API)
- quant suggestion (heuristic + link to evaluation job logs)
- eval-alert webhook (one metric: avg MRR, user-configurable threshold)
No rich UI for alpha — just API + console links. Thumbs? :thumbsup:

jordan: +1 from ML. I'll draft an eval job template we can run on pilot datasets.

samir: Strong NO on auto-applying quant. Recommend-only with explicit validation step.

eva: Pilot ask list: AcmeCorp and DataLoom want cost delta in USD. They want a mock run on last 7 days of traffic. I'll confirm samples.

alex: Rough eng estimate: backend + telemetry + API = 3 sprints; basic console link + export = 1 sprint. Need eng-ml pairing for evaluation infra.

maya: Launch criteria (alpha):
1) Recommendations are actionable via API/export.
2) Eval-alert webhook fires in staging and FP rate <= 50% for pilot (we'll refine).
3) At least 2 pilot customers onboarded and given report.
Deadline: aim for end of Q2 for alpha. Feels tight.

jordan: End of Q2 is aggressive. Recommend alpha by end of Q2 but with limited telemetry (no dollar-cost UI).

maya: Action items:
- alex: telemetry schema + eng estimate by Tue
- jordan: eval job template + sample webhook payload by Tue
- samir: quant heuristic doc (what we can safely recommend) by Fri
- eva: confirm pilot contact + sample data by Tue
I'll consolidate into a short PRD after that.

alex: noted. Will post progress in #eng-ml and ping if blocked.

ci-bot: deploy-bot: Created issue #6123: "optimize-toolkit: MVP scope (batching, quant, eval-alert webhook)" — https://redwood.example/issue/6123

maya: Thanks all — keeping follow-ups concise in-thread.
